title: CSA technical diagram model
description: The input every renderer takes (screen SVG, print SVG, PNG, Word drawing, Word document). Built from evidence by model.overview and views.*; saved per figure as csa-work/figures/<KEY>/model.json. Nothing in it is invented: every edge cites evidence, and anything unknown is drawn as such (kind unknown or gap, status unknown).

id.description: Stable id, e.g. figure-time or system-overview.

zones.description: Network and security zones, in page order. Ids with meaning: it (IT, enterprise and Internet), shared (shared services), nosite (site not recorded), outside (location not captured), site:<name> (another site), and one id per data centre listed in layout.dcs.

groups.description: Systems that belong together inside one zone, e.g. SQL cluster nodes. A group whose members connect identically is drawn as one card at print size.

id.description: Host name exactly as the evidence writes it, or a synthetic id (G-INTERNAL, G-INTERNET, GAP-OT).

role.description: The role recorded in the host register; never derived from the name.

tier.description: Row inside a data centre: net, access, app, db, ot.

kind_basis.description: Why this kind: the recorded role, or 'No role recorded'.

host.description: True for a host in the register (not a roll-up or gap marker).

s.description: Source node, group or Z:<zone> for a whole zone.

label.description: Protocol, port and process as captured, one per line; never invented.

short.description: Label used at print size (e.g. '1st', 'not in use').

status.description: Evidence status, drawn as the line style: observed in captures, configured setting, configured but not in use, inferred, documented only, path not captured, crosses a zone with no control evidenced, admin protocol from outside OT with no jump host, admin path through a jump host.

evidence.description: Evidence matrix IDs (E-nnn) or capture file lines.

notes.description: Findings about the figure; shown on the page and in the standalone Word document, not inside the drawing.

layout.description: Added by model._layout: dcs (data centres left to right), top, bottom, tiers.
